title: The Autopsy of Ashcombe
author: Quentin Almeida
blurb: Paloma Underhill, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
